parent_idea: Preprints with shorter titles collect more citations at two years because search engines retrieve them more often. If so, shortening titles is a cheap lever for visibility.

ideas.title: Same retrieval test on non-preprint records
ideas.statement: Since the retrieval effect held on preprints, extend its scope to journal records of the same fields.

materials.why: The confirmed retrieval effect to be extended.

mechanism.summary: Rank gain from term coverage also holds in engines that index journal records.
mechanism.goal: Extend the confirmed retrieval effect to another population.

hypothesis.statement: The paired rank gain measured on preprints also appears on journal records.
hypothesis.false_if: The gain is absent on journal records of the same fields.

test.one_line: Replay T1 on 200 journal records in the same engine with the same positive control.
test.if_holds: A gain of the same sign and similar size.

queries: retrieval rank gain journal records title rewrite

closest_work.title: Title wording and retrieval of journal records
closest_work.what_differs: Observational; no paired rewrite of the same record.

prior_art.difference: The closest work is observational; the idea adds the paired rewrite.

tool.name: pandas and a title-rewrite script
tool.access: local script of the T1 apparatus

ideas.teaches: Whether the confirmed mechanism is specific to preprints.

uncertainties: Journals may rewrite titles at copy editing.

ideas.title: Transfer to dataset titles in data repositories
ideas.statement: Transfer the confirmed retrieval lever to the titles of datasets in open data repositories.

analogy.corresponds: Both rank records by match between query terms and the title field.
analogy.breaks: Dataset search also uses file formats and licence filters.

materials.why: The confirmed lever to be transferred.

mechanism.summary: Dataset search ranks dataset titles by term match as scholarly search does for papers.
mechanism.goal: Transfer a lever on retrieval to another record type.

hypothesis.statement: Rewriting a dataset title for term coverage raises its rank in repository search.
hypothesis.false_if: Repository search ignores the title field.

test.one_line: Paired rank test of 100 dataset titles rewritten in one open repository, with a placebo rewrite.
test.if_holds: Rank gain of the rewrite above the placebo.
test.if_fails: No difference between rewrite and placebo.

queries: dataset title rewrite repository search rank
prior_art.scope: OpenAlex and one repository index, documents dated before 2026-11-14.

ideas.teaches: Whether the lever transfers across record types.

gains: A new population at low cost.
costs: The repository engine is a black box.
uncertainties: Dataset search may be dominated by keywords.

ranking.basis: Feasibility from verifiable elements, cheapest minimal test, and what each idea would teach for the next decision; scenarios, no score.

scenarios.if: The researcher wants the cheapest follow-up.
scenarios.why: It replays T1 as is on another population.
